evidence: workload/trace_to_two_pool.py docstring L7-8,L15-18: 'each request's vision-pool delay already folded into its LLM-arrival timestamp' — an open-loop request that spends encoder_delay in the vision pool is emitted as arriving at the LLM pool encoder_delay LATER by shifting its timestamp forward (the trace seam). This is strict serialization: no overlap of encoder and prefill is modeled, so composed TTFT is an upper bound — overlap could only reduce it (conservative). twopool.tex:44,409-412 states the same.
